title: [FMLA 11] SeriesLRC — Impedance LRC Series
summary: Series RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; the ROM uses 2πf, not a separate ω prompt.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: SeriesLRC. Series RLC impedance at frequency f. Type f in Hz; do not type ω into the f prompt.
R, L, and C sit in one line. At most frequencies they fight each other and Z is large. At one special frequency (resonance) the L and C parts cancel, and only R remains.

body.caption: Example R = 10 Ω, L = 0.1 H, C = 1 µF. Series impedance Z is smallest at the resonant frequency f₀ ≈ 503 Hz, where Z ≈ R.

body.text: Primary inputs: f, R, L, C (frequency in Hz, not ω).

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 1, then 1 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Units
body.text: SI: f in Hz, L in H, C in F, R and Z in Ω (all > 0). The formula uses 2πf; there is no ω input.
